easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
